APIID.description: Optional AgentBody capability identifier returned by usage history. Use it only to filter this API key's usage records.
APIID.name: api_id

Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding response. Omit it on the first request. Do not construct, modify, or reuse it outside this pagination flow.
Cursor.name: cursor

From.description: Inclusive UTC start time for a usage query, formatted as RFC 3339.
From.name: from

HashtagID.description: Platform hashtag identifier returned by a hashtag search result.
HashtagID.name: hashtag_id

IdempotencyKey.description: Optional key for safely retrying a billable write request.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

Language.description: Optional BCP 47 language preference, such as en. Omit it to accept the source language.
Language.name: language

Latitude.description: Latitude of the location to search, in decimal degrees.
Latitude.name: latitude

Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. The Gateway may return fewer results.
Limit.name: limit

Longitude.description: Longitude of the location to search, in decimal degrees.
Longitude.name: longitude

MusicID.description: Platform music identifier returned by a music search result.
MusicID.name: music_id

PostCode.description: Instagram post shortcode. For https://www.instagram.com/p/DcLs3w6GZGH/, use DcLs3w6GZGH. Do not pass the full URL.
PostCode.name: post_code

PostID.description: Platform post identifier extracted from the public post URL when the operation accepts an ID.
PostID.name: post_id

PostIDOptional.description: Optional platform post identifier extracted from the public post URL.
PostIDOptional.name: post_id

PostURN.description: LinkedIn post URN or numeric post identifier required by the comments capability.
PostURN.name: post_urn

ProfileURL.description: A publicly reachable LinkedIn person profile URL.
ProfileURL.name: profile_url

Query.description: Search phrase supplied by the user. Do not include provider-specific query syntax unless documented by the operation.
Query.name: query

RedditPostID.description: Reddit post ID. Accepts either the bare base36 ID from a Reddit URL (for example, 1vt6xlx) or the typed fullname t3_1vt6xlx.
RedditPostID.name: post_id

SecUserID.description: TikTok sec_user_id returned together with user_id by an earlier TikTok result; use both values together.
SecUserID.name: sec_user_id

Subreddit.description: Public subreddit name, with or without the r/ prefix.
Subreddit.name: subreddit

To.description: Exclusive UTC end time for a usage query, formatted as RFC 3339.
To.name: to

URL.description: A publicly reachable HTTPS URL. Do not submit private, authenticated, redirect-only, or user-specific URLs.
URL.name: url

URLRequired.description: A publicly reachable HTTPS URL. Do not submit private, authenticated, redirect-only, or user-specific URLs.
URLRequired.name: url

UserID.description: TikTok user_id returned by an earlier TikTok profile or search result.
UserID.name: user_id

Username.description: The platform username without a leading @. Use the public profile identifier.
Username.name: username

UsernameOptional.description: The platform username without a leading @. Use the public profile identifier.
UsernameOptional.name: username

VideoID.description: TikTok video identifier extracted from a public TikTok video URL.
VideoID.name: video_id

VideoURL.description: A publicly reachable HTTPS URL. Do not submit private, authenticated, redirect-only, or user-specific URLs.
VideoURL.name: url
